starting_principles: 2D Kinematics in tilted coordinate frame aligned with inclined plane of slope alpha
assumptions: Plane inclined at constant angle alpha to horizontal
Launch angle theta > alpha relative to horizontal

ordered_steps.action_description: Align x'-axis along incline and y'-axis normal to incline; resolve initial velocity and gravity
ordered_steps.equation_latex: u_{x'} = u \cos(\theta - \alpha), \quad u_{y'} = u \sin(\theta - \alpha); \quad a_{x'} = -g\sin\alpha, \quad a_{y'} = -g\cos\alpha

ordered_steps.action_description: Determine time of flight T by setting perpendicular displacement to zero y'(T) = 0
ordered_steps.equation_latex: y'(T) = u_{y'} T - \frac{1}{2} g\cos\alpha T^2 = 0 \implies T = \frac{2 u \sin(\theta - \alpha)}{g\cos\alpha}
ordered_steps.justification: Projectile lands on incline when perpendicular coordinate returns to zero.

ordered_steps.action_description: Compute range R_up by evaluating x'(T)
ordered_steps.equation_latex: R_{\text{up}} = u_{x'} T - \frac{1}{2} g\sin\alpha T^2 = T \left( u\cos(\theta - \alpha) - \frac{1}{2} g\sin\alpha \frac{2 u\sin(\theta - \alpha)}{g\cos\alpha} \right)
ordered_steps.justification: Kinematic position along x' under constant acceleration a_x' = -g sin(alpha).

ordered_steps.action_description: Combine over common denominator cos(alpha) and apply angle addition identity
ordered_steps.justification: Trigonometric identity cos(A + B) = cos A cos B - sin A sin B.

ordered_steps.action_description: Substitute flight time T into the simplified range expression

applicability_conditions: Valid for projectile launch up an incline of slope angle alpha with theta > alpha
source_references: Concepts of Physics Vol 1 by H.C. Verma (Chapter 3, pp. 58-59)
